rawContent: Just saw this unfold live. Cameras kept rolling despite crew being arrested, which an anchor called a fitting metaphor. We must stay alert & watching, esp non-Black allies. We can’t turn a blind eye to injustice & racism in our neighborhds #BlackLivesMatter #JusticeForGeorgeFloyd

This Wed, I will participate in #ShutDownAcademia #ShutDownSTEM & I encourage all my non-Black colleagues to do the same. I commit to read, write, and reflect on the racist history of academia/sci & identify anti-racism actions that I can take every single day #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/K65KfjvITu

Yesterday we #ShutDownAcademia #ShutDownSTEM to #strike4Blacklives bc #BLACKLIVESMATTER. I read & compiled the resources that I found helpful in actively challenging anti-Black racism w/ other intersecting systems of oppression. Always taking additions! https://t.co/9n3mfMUm3u
